gripOrHq.title: R&D Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

gripOrHq.title: R&D Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

gripOrHq.title: Zetatech Software Installer
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

gripOrHq.title: Top Runners' Conference
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Forged Activation Orders
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

scoreArea.title: Artificial Security Directors
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Black Ops agendas is reduced by 1.

rig.title: Deep Thought
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Rigged Investments
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: On-Call Solo Team
scoreArea.rulesText: A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
